split_method: Deterministic author-assigned topic groups with disjoint gold document/page pairs between dev and test; no random sampling.
query_inputs: filter only for strategy C when nonempty
filter_provenance: Exact section title explicitly present in the question; verified against headings in data/section_boundaries.json. Not inferred from gold during retrieval.
section_handling: Use data/processed/sections.jsonl or page-level metadata.section_spans. Future chunks must preserve section boundaries and the scalar section value. A mixed page must not be assigned one arbitrary section.
hit_definition: A chunk has a documented gold source/page and enough evidence to support the full answer, or equivalent evidence confirmed and logged by the reviewer. A source/page match alone is insufficient.
hit_at_1: Number of questions whose first chunk is a hit divided by total questions in that split; report n/N.
evidence_hit_at_3: Number of questions with at least one hit among the first three chunks divided by total questions in that split; report n/N.
alternative_gold_policy: gold_evidence contains the primary passage and confirmed alternatives. Accept any one complete valid entry; do not require all alternative passages. Record additional equivalent evidence if encountered; do not mark it wrong solely for differing from the primary source.
multi_chunk_policy: Evidence combined across several chunks may be reported separately, but does not replace the required single-chunk hit definition.
dev_selection_rule_before_test: Then lowest measured ingestion time under the same timing procedure
Then lexicographic strategy name for a deterministic tie
test_policy: Fix strategy parameters using dev and record the chosen strategy before running test. Evaluate all three fixed strategies on test without using test results to tune. If test is used for tuning, disclose contamination rather than claiming an independent holdout.
known_limits: Only 20 questions and 5 test cases; no claim of statistical significance or general superiority.
Both papers discuss 3D GS and share concepts; gold-page separation is not document-level or strict semantic independence.
Vietnamese queries against English evidence measure cross-language retrieval as well as ingestion strategy.

dev12 intentionally requires a long 960-character passage covering two directions and their compatibility; small chunks may split the necessary evidence. Log this failure rather than changing gold after seeing test.
AI-assisted question/answer authoring and semantic review; no claim of student/human verification or retrieval performance.

authorship.author: Codex AI assistant
authorship.evidence_review: AI semantic review plus programmatic exact substring/offset/source/page/section checks

retrieval_results_at_freeze: No embeddings, vector search or retrieval benchmark have been run. Corpus/benchmark validation is not retrieval evaluation.
